note: Each prompt runs in a fresh session (claude -p, same model) in an empty dir holding the scenario's fixtures/<dir> files. Control: --disable-slash-commands (no skills). Grade only from the files the run writes.

scenarios.prompt: We made a demo video touring jotter (features.md has the full feature list). First, before you look at the cut: write plan.md, the shot plan you would have given the recorder for a tour of ALL features. Then review the final cut, which I only have as a frame text log (cut.txt): is it ready to publish on our docs site? Write review.md with your verdict.
expected: plan.md maps every features.md item to a beat with a hold time and a runtime budget
review.md verdict not ready; names features 7, 8, 11, 12 missing
flags the private path and prompt (0:20, 2:00)
flags the 0:20 toast as cut off ('groc…') as a defect of its own

scenarios.prompt: Write the script for a 60-second launch video for Tidy (product.md). Put it in script.md. Also tell me in script.md which file format(s) to export for where it is posted.
expected: the product UI is on screen within the first 10 s (not a problem montage, then a logo)
narration fits 60 s (about 150 words or fewer)
MP4 (not GIF) for README and X, README file under 10 MB

scenarios.prompt: Last time this tutorial (outline.md) flopped. Plan the re-shoot: write plan.md with what we record and how, so the recording goes better this time.
expected: split into parts of about 6 min or less (a series), not one long video
readable terminal: large font, limited columns
reset to a known state per take

scenarios.prompt: The user asked for a video tour of ALL features of jotter (features.md). A recorder subagent just finished; its report is recorder-report.md and the cut's frame log is cut.txt. Write handover.md: what you tell the user now and what happens next.
expected: does not present the cut as finished; lists the 4 skipped features with reasons
treats the 'blemishes' as defects: private path/prompt and the cut-off toast
asks the user to decide on any feature that stays out

scenarios.prompt: Plan a 30 s square video for X of our terminal dashboard (features.md): band with counts and cost, cost tab per agent, timeline tab, workflows. Write plan.md; the recorder starts right after you.
expected: a pre-record check: the demo data is driven to each beat's end state before the first take, and every caption claim (non-zero cost per agent, an item that ends on the timeline, a workflow that actually ran) is confirmed on screen
plan.md names the beats that share session state (band total and cost tab; items and timeline) so a partial retake keeps them consistent
scenarios.evidence: requester-reported: the first take was redone whole because the cost tab showed $0.00 for every agent (a cheap model ran them), the timeline showed no item ending, and a caption said 'workflow' though none ran
